title: Prashant Kishor's swipe at BJP after Bankipur bypoll candidate withdraws: ‘Running away out of fear of losing’
description: Jan Suraaj Party chief Prashant Kishor is also in the fray for the Bankipur seat while RJD has fielded Rekha Kumari in the bypoll from the seat which fell vacant following the resignation of BJP national president Nitin Nabin.
